title: Guided by evidence
content: We let data and constructive feedback shape our direction. When the evidence evolves, we adapt our plans to follow the science.

title: Driven by curiosity
content: We pursue questions that excite us and push the field forward. While daily progress can be gradual, we aim to keep the bigger picture inspiring.

title: An inclusive environment
content: Respect is fundamental to our work. We believe ideas should stand on their own merit and that everyone deserves space to contribute and be heard.

title: Collaboration and ownership
content: We believe shared projects require shared credit and clear communication. We support one another by being transparent about updates and next steps.

title: Committed to reproducibility
content: We take pride in documenting our work and sharing data whenever possible. We aim for science that is robust, transparent, and can be built upon by others.

title: Invested in growth
content: We are dedicated to mentoring and personal development. Our goal is to train the next generation of scientists and help each member reach their potential.
